publicationGate.reason: The local digest contains extracted text and provider-generated vectors from sources with mixed reuse terms. Publish only a scrubbed, explicitly redistributable export after source-by-source licence and privacy review.
requiredBeforeReady: Review every document's redistribution right and attribution requirement.
Remove documents and user-derived material that are not cleared for public redistribution.
Create a stable checkpointed SQLite snapshot and verify its integrity.
Upload the compressed snapshot as a GitHub Release asset and fill artifact.url, artifact.sha256, and artifact.sizeBytes.
Change status to ready only after the release asset and checksums have been verified.
